title: Capability port and fidelity
situation: Record corrections, 2026-10-13: an independent architect read the design record cold and found settled decisions contradicting the current design, terms used but never defined, and concepts that disagree; the operator asked for the corrections to be applied. Decision 0009 no longer matches the current design.
decision: Each capability has one implementation, the runtime, reached through the cratylus command. A harness reaches it through a thin adapter that adds no behaviour, at the highest fidelity the harness offers: its native facility, then a cratylus extension, then prose only as a last resort. Each capability explains itself, and no skill restates it.
consequences: The record now states this as the standing rule.
